concerns.text: FR-007 and SC-008 require reporting if GNN test MAE ≤ 0.05 e to validate the hypothesis. Task T044 implements the check but is unchecked. Without T044, the system cannot validate the hypothesis as required by the spec.

FR-005 and SC-001/SC-002 require calculating and reporting MAE, RMSE, and Pearson R. Task T042 implements metric calculation but is unchecked. Task T047 (aggregating metrics) is also unchecked. These are required to fulfill the reporting requirement.

FR-006 and SC-003 require comparing 3D GNN vs 2D GNN vs Atom-Type baseline. Task T043 implements baseline comparison but is unchecked. Task T046 (exit code logic for baseline loss) is unchecked. Without these, the baseline comparison requirement is not met.

Constitution Principle IV (Single Source of Truth) and US-3 acceptance scenario 1 require generating a report programmatically. Task T048 (render final report) is unchecked. Without this, the report generation requirement is not fulfilled.

US-1 acceptance scenario 1 requires outputting a summary of loaded feature dimensions. Task T016 adds logging for loaded feature dimensions but is unchecked. Without T016, the summary output requirement is not met.
FR-004 requires a scaffold-based split with a fixed random seed. Task T009a executes the scaffold split but is unchecked. Without T009a, the scaffold split requirement is not met.

FR-004 requires partitioning data into train/val/test sets. Task T009a generates split indices but is unchecked. Task T023c wires split indices but is unchecked. Without these, the data partitioning requirement is not met.
FR-003 requires training with early stopping based on validation MAE. Task T023b implements early stopping but is unchecked. Without T023b, the early stopping requirement is not met.
FR-003 requires training for a maximum of 100 epochs. Task T023 implements the training loop but is unchecked. Without T023, the training loop requirement is not met.
FR-002 requires implementing a Geometric GNN architecture. Task T020 implements the architecture but is unchecked. Without T020, the GNN implementation requirement is not met.
FR-006 requires implementing a connectivity-only GNN baseline. Task T021 implements the baseline but is unchecked. Without T021, the baseline implementation requirement is not met.
FR-006 requires implementing an Atom-Type Average baseline. Task T022 implements the baseline but is unchecked. Without T022, the baseline implementation requirement is not met.
FR-003 requires saving model weights. Task T024 implements model checkpointing but is unchecked. Without T024, the model saving requirement is not met.
FR-001 requires loading QM9 dataset with Merz-Kollman charges. Task T012 implements the dataset loader but is unchecked. Without T012, the data loading requirement is not met.

FR-001 requires validating data integrity (non-null charges, connectivity alignment). Task T015 implements validation checks but is unchecked. Without T015, the data validation requirement is not met.
FR-001 requires ensuring memory footprint remains ≤ 7 GB. Task T014 implements dynamic memory calculation but is unchecked. Without T014, the memory constraint requirement is not met.
FR-001 requires handling missing coordinates or undefined bonds. Task T015 implements filtering/imputation strategy but is unchecked. Without T015, the edge case handling requirement is not met.
FR-004 requires using RDKit's Bemis-Murcko scaffold extraction. Task T008 implements scaffold extraction but is unchecked. Without T008, the scaffold extraction requirement is not met.
FR-004 requires using a fixed random seed of 42. Task T009 implements split logic with a fixed seed but is unchecked. Without T009, the random seed requirement is not met.

FR-001 requires extracting atomic coordinates, bond connectivity, and ESP-derived partial charges. Task T005 defines the MoleculeData class with these attributes but is unchecked. Without T005, the data model requirement is not met.
FR-001 requires coordinate normalization (center of mass). Task T007 implements coordinate normalization but is unchecked. Without T007, the normalization requirement is not met.

FR-001 requires memory profiling and adaptive sampling. Task T006 sets up memory profiling but is unchecked. Task T006a orchestrates the probe-calculate-adapt sequence but is unchecked. Without these, the memory management requirement is not met.
FR-001 requires a Python 3.11 project with pinned dependencies. Task T002 initializes the project with dependencies but is unchecked. Without T002, the project setup requirement is not met.
FR-001 requires project structure per implementation plan. Task T001 creates the project structure but is unchecked. Without T001, the project structure requirement is not met.
FR-001 requires linting and formatting configuration. Task T003 configures linting and formatting but is unchecked. Without T003, the code quality requirement is not met.
FR-001 requires seed setting and logging utility. Task T004 implements seed setting and logging but is unchecked. Without T004, the utility requirement is not met.
